def equation(t, A, params):
    g = params[0] + params[1]/t + params[2]*np.sqrt(t) + params[3]*t*np.log(t) + params[4]/np.sqrt(t) + params[5]*t + params[6]*np.log(t)
    return g + (params[7] + params[8]*np.sqrt(t) + params[9]*t**2)*A**2
